error_page_body: The page couldn't be rendered. Retry, head home, or share the details below with support.
not_found_body: The page you're looking for may have moved, been removed, or never existed. Check the address or head back to a familiar place.
overview_body: Workspace-level overview for this organization. Analytics, activity, and quick actions will land here.
agents_page_subtitle: Pick an agent to manage its knowledge base, web sources, and skills.
agents_page_empty: No agents registered for this tenant.
try_out_title: Open this agent + version in the chat SPA
versions_body: Every version defined for this agent in the catalog. Exactly one is enabled ("live") at a time; toggles are read-only until version management lands.
tools_body: Tools attached to this agent version. Every entry in the catalog is enabled; toggles are read-only until per-tool disable lands.
tools_empty: No tools declared for this agent version.
kb_root_body: Documents indexed into the vector store, and web sources ingested straight into the KB.
kb_upload_body: PDF, DOCX, TXT, HTML, or Markdown. File and sidecar are presigned to S3; Bedrock ingestion is triggered after upload.
kb_docs_body: Files under the KB prefix in S3 for this scope. Ingestion status lives in Bedrock; refresh to re-check.
kb_docs_empty: No documents uploaded for this version.
kb_web_seed_body: Ingest a single page — or toggle "follow sitemap" to crawl every URL the site lists (up to 100, throttled to 1 request/sec).
kb_web_seed_summary_single_fallback: Indexed 1 page (no sitemap found; ingested as single URL).
kb_web_list_body: Documents currently in the web data source. Statuses come from Bedrock.
skills_upload_body: Zip archive or a single SKILL.md file.
skills_list_body: Skills the agent can invoke via the tools bus.
debug_drawer_body: Inline editor for the S3-hosted catalog. Save writes through the middleware (PUT /agents/catalog).
